caseNameFull: Kent-Coffey Mfg. Co. v. Maxwell, Commissioner of Revenue of North Carolina
attorneys: Messrs. Mark Squires and Samuel J. Ervin, Jr., for appellant. Mr. Dennis G. Brummitt, Attorney General of North Carolina, with whom Mr. A. A. F. Seawell, Assistant Attorney General, was on the brief, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

This case, is controlled by the decision in Underwood Typewriter Co. v. Chamberlain, 254 U.S. 113, and not by the decision in Hans Rees’ Sons v. North Carolina, 283 U.S. 123. The judgment is affirmed.
